title: Conformational switch of NPC1 epitomizes a lumen-to-membrane alternating access model for nonpolar substrates.
authors: Wu, Xuelan; Dehghani-Ghahnaviyeh, Sepehr; Rasouli, Ali; Malona, John A; Antalek, Mitchell; Jones, Lyn H; Fan, Xiao; Peng, Adele; Tajkhorshid, Emad; Qian, Hongwu; Yan, Nieng
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过冷冻电镜结构和分子动力学模拟揭示NPC1-NPC2复合物的构象转换及胆固醇转运的交替访问机制，核心对象为膜蛋白NPC1的结构构象，问题聚焦于构象采样与转运机制，方法结合结构解析和MD模拟，与蛋白质结构计算课题高度相关。
abstract: Niemann-Pick disease type C (NPC) arises from failure of the NPC1 and/or NPC2 proteins to mobilize lysosomal cholesterol, yet the mechanism by which the complex drives sterol translocation lacks a thorough understanding. Here, we capture an NPC1-NPC2 complex conformation at lysosomal pH using a bis-sterol ligand (JM046), fortifying NPC2 engagement with NPC1 and enabling structural characterization of an alternative transport state. In this complex, the sterol moiety is absent from the NPC1 central tunnel, and the neck site adopts an expanded architecture that resembles a previously observed NPC1 conformation at neutral pH, indicating that the tunnel geometry may not be influenced by the pH alone. Instead, we provide evidence that cholesterol occupancy in the neck site is a key determinant of tunnel contraction. Supporting this notion, NPC1 purified from cholesterol-auxotrophic insect cells exhibits a similarly expanded neck conformation. Integrating these structures and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations exploring the directional cholesterol handoff from NPC2 to the NPC1 tunnel, we propose a substrate-induced gating cycle where luminal and membrane-facing openings of NPC1 switch states in a coordinated manner to transfer cholesterol across the hydrophilic glycocalyx, reminiscent of the alternating access mechanism of membrane transporters. This framework synthesizes NPC1 conformational states into a mechanistic basis that may be used to map pathogenic NPC variants to their relevant transport steps.
abstract_zh: Niemann-Pick病C型（NPC）源于NPC1和/或NPC2蛋白无法动员溶酶体胆固醇，然而该复合物驱动甾醇转运的机制尚缺乏深入理解。在此，我们利用双甾醇配体（JM046）在溶酶体pH下捕获了NPC1-NPC2复合物构象，增强了NPC2与NPC1的结合，并实现了替代转运状态的结构表征。在该复合物中，甾醇部分缺失于NPC1中央通道，且颈部位点采用扩展架构，类似于先前在中性pH下观察到的NPC1构象，表明通道几何形状可能并非仅受pH影响。相反，我们提供证据表明，颈部位点的胆固醇占据是通道收缩的关键决定因素。支持这一观点的是，从胆固醇营养缺陷型昆虫细胞中纯化的NPC1表现出类似的扩展颈部构象。整合这些结构及探索NPC2向NPC1通道定向胆固醇传递的分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟，我们提出一种底物诱导的门控循环，其中NPC1的腔内和膜面开口以协调方式切换状态，以将胆固醇跨过亲水性糖萼转运，类似于膜转运蛋白的交替访问机制。该框架将NPC1构象状态综合为机制基础，可用于将致病性NPC变异映射至其相关转运步骤。
